rules.description: All output files pass structural validation
Every school has a unique campus identity
Every school is physically located in India
Every fee matches its source, academic year and fee type
Every student count matches its source and reporting year
Every curriculum marked verified matches official evidence
Every historical event has dated supporting evidence
No fabricated, unsupported or mock values presented as facts
Every unresolved conflict is visible and none is presented as verified
Every premium category follows the configured rules
Every MASTEREDGE fit assessment is labelled analysis and recomputable
Every reported percentage is recalculated from the final data
Every CEO report number matches the final JSON
Every factual report row includes its source reference
Independently audited factual accuracy on the audited sample
Validator did not modify any validated file

gates.label: Evidence coverage for reported factual claims
